summary: {member} sends a participation report back for a breakdown by course and group of players.
realLife: Portland's adopted note called for reporting changes by course and demographic group as well as overall use.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: attendance before and after the rate date by course and group.

turns.pulledBy: Attendance holds steady overall but falls among younger players at one course.
turns.what: The member asks staff to examine that rate.
turns.writesBack: The review identifies the site and group.

turns.pulledBy: A cheaper rate draws more visits from existing players.
turns.what: The member asks whether new players also enrolled.
turns.writesBack: The next report separates people from repeat visits.
